import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

_CUDA_SRC = r"""
#include <cuda.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_bf16.h>
#include <cublas_v2.h>
#include <ATen/cuda/CUDAContext.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>

#define CUDA_CHECK(call) do {                                      \
    cudaError_t err = (call);                                      \
    if (err != cudaSuccess) {                                      \
        printf("CUDA error %s at %s:%d\n",                         \
               cudaGetErrorString(err), __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
    }                                                             \
} while(0)

#define CUBLAS_CHECK(call) do {                                    \
    cublasStatus_t st = (call);                                    \
    if (st != CUBLAS_STATUS_SUCCESS) {                             \
        printf("CUBLAS error %d at %s:%d\n",                       \
               (int)st, __FILE__, __LINE__);                       \
    }                                                             \
} while(0)

__global__ void bf16_gemm_small_kernel(
    const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ A,
    const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ B,
    __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ C,
    int M, int K, int N
) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    int total = M * N;
    if (idx >= total) return;

    int row = idx / N;
    int col = idx - row * N;

    float acc = 0.0f;
    for (int kk = 0; kk < K; ++kk) {
        float a = __bfloat162float(A[row * K + kk]);
        float b = __bfloat162float(B[kk * N + col]);
        acc = fmaf(a, b, acc);
    }

    C[idx] = __float2bfloat16(acc);
}

void run_gemm_h100(
    int64_t A_ptr,
    int64_t B_ptr,
    int64_t C_ptr,
    int M,
    int K,
    int N
) {
    const __nv_bfloat16* A = reinterpret_cast<const __nv_bfloat16*>(A_ptr);
    const __nv_bfloat16* B = reinterpret_cast<const __nv_bfloat16*>(B_ptr);
    __nv_bfloat16* C = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(C_ptr);

    cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();

    long long work = (long long)M * (long long)N * (long long)K;

    if (work <= 262144LL) {
        int total = M * N;
        int block = 256;
        int grid = (total + block - 1) / block;
        bf16_gemm_small_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(A, B, C, M, K, N);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        return;
    }

    static cublasHandle_t handle = nullptr;
    if (handle == nullptr) {
        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&handle));
        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetMathMode(handle, CUBLAS_TENSOR_OP_MATH));
    }

    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(handle, stream));

    float alpha = 1.0f;
    float beta = 0.0f;

    // Row-major C[M, N] = A[M, K] @ B[K, N].
    // cuBLAS is column-major, so compute:
    // C^T[N, M] = B^T[N, K] @ A^T[K, M]
    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasGemmEx(
        handle,
        CUBLAS_OP_N,
        CUBLAS_OP_N,
        N,
        M,
        K,
        &alpha,
        B,
        CUDA_R_16BF,
        N,
        A,
        CUDA_R_16BF,
        K,
        &beta,
        C,
        CUDA_R_16BF,
        N,
        CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F,
        CUBLAS_GEMM_DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP
    ));
}
"""

_CPP_SRC = """
#include <cstdint>

void run_gemm_h100(
    int64_t A_ptr,
    int64_t B_ptr,
    int64_t C_ptr,
    int M,
    int K,
    int N
);
"""

_ext = None

def _get_ext():
    global _ext
    if _ext is None:
        _ext = load_inline(
            name="bf16_gemm_h100_cublas_ext",
            cpp_sources=_CPP_SRC,
            cuda_sources=_CUDA_SRC,
            functions=["run_gemm_h100"],
            extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"],
            extra_ldflags=["-lcublas"],
            verbose=False,
        )
    return _ext


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(self, inputs: dict) -> dict:
        A = inputs["A"].contiguous()
        B = inputs["B"].contiguous()

        M, K = A.shape
        N = B.shape[1]

        C = torch.empty((M, N), dtype=A.dtype, device=A.device)

        _get_ext().run_gemm_h100(
            A.data_ptr(),
            B.data_ptr(),
            C.data_ptr(),
            int(M),
            int(K),
            int(N),
        )

        return {"C": C}
